about: The collecta of the formulary “Transferred Sixth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, ever to think of spiritual things and in every word and work always to do what is well pleasing in Your sight. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
